basic_info.description: Charming & Lovely! Welcome to this Fully Detached Single-Family Home in the Heart of Sunny Visitacion Valley!  Warm and inviting, this well-maintained residence offers approximately 1,168 sqft of comfortable living space(per sketch), featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a primary suite. The main level boasts a sun-drenched living/dining area with high ceilings & hardwood floors, a beautifully updated kitchen with custom cabinetry and granite countertops, and two bedrooms with two full baths, one of which is an en suite primary. Downstairs, you'll find a third bedroom, a versatile laundry/utility room with washer and dryer installed, and plenty of extra storage. Step outside to a tranquil good sized backyard surrounded by avocado tree & plum tree, perfect for weekend BBQs, gardening, or relaxing under the sun. Ideally located with easy freeway access to Downtown SF and SFO, this home is also just a short stroll from McLaren Park, Coffman Pool, and the charming shops and cafes along Leland Street. Commuters will love the convenience of nearby Caltrain and MUNI lines (T-Line, 56, 8 & 9). Don't miss this must-see opportunity!
